newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound interbank rates rise in Sunday market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound interbank rates rise in Sunday market.

text.p: A squeezed private sector market raised overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound on Sunday to between 10 and 10-1/4 percent from Thursday's range of 9-3/4 and 10 percent, bankers said.
The market is usually tight on Sundays, the beginning of the banking week.
One week rates were also higher at around 10-1/4 percent from 10-1/8 percent, they added. Some bankers said they made one-month deals at rates between 10 and 10-3/16 percent.
State-owned banks kept their minimum interbank lending rate at 10-1/2 percent, bankers said.
